name: dealing
description: Player-to-player drug dealing. `peddle <drug> to <player> [for <price>]` opens a priced offer the buyer accepts with `acceptdeal` (or `declinedeal`); the seller can `canceldeal`. Price is hard-clamped to a potency-based fair value ±25% (no gouge, no dump). Atomic pay + hand-off at accept; emits `item.given` on the seller so surveillance witness-rolls the `drug_dealing` charge. Same-room, one dose per deal, 60s TTL.
